title: Subscription token (sent and expected) logged at Information level during grant probing
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: Webhooks.API/
rationale: Both token-bearing log statements are lowered to Debug (behind IsEnabled guards, matching WebhooksSender's established pattern) and the values replaced by MaskToken output: '<absent>' or '<present sha256=XXXXXXXX>' — the security decision itself still compares real values. WebhookClient's own token log is a separate finding (not touched).
variants_checked: GrantUrlTesterService.cs:17 and :25 are the only token-bearing logs in Webhooks.API; WebhooksSender already omits the token at Debug; WebhookClient Endpoints:35 is a separate process/finding.
bypass_considered: Grant-URL servers can no longer recover a victim's expected token from Information logs; hash prefix is correlation-only and appears only at Debug level.
test_note: Omitted — functional tests stub IGrantUrlTesterService entirely; no Webhooks.API unit-test project exists; verify post-apply via git grep LogInformation.
review_reason: Root-cause fix: the plaintext secret is removed from the only two leaking statements, at the right level, with diagnosability preserved by a non-invertible prefix.
